comparison.objective: Candidate mounts a rack rail; record scribes a complete circle around a fixed punch mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs multi-site alignment, spring latching, telescoping, and tool fastening; record maintains a divider pivot under pressure while sweeping a full rotational path.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires mechanical retention and prescribed fasteners; record requires continuous pivot seating, adequate angular coverage, an accurate irreversible mark, and tool return.
comparison.reason: Continuous constrained scribing tests a different ability from structural installation. Candidate's missing numeric force and alignment tolerances are not evidence of overlap.
